page.notes: Doubtful readings: "ỹ" in the title is an unusual mark, possibly a versicle sign, transcribed with [?]. The last word of the page, "filia", is at the right edge and may be clipped, so it is marked [?]. "observuo" and "euangelisan-tis" are copied as printed. The running head is omitted because the page opens a division. The Google watermark in the lower right and the small dash at the foot are not printed text and are omitted.
